flowchart:
flowchart LR
  start([Start]) --> check{Is it valid?}
  check -- yes --> ok[Render SVG]
  check -- no --> fail[Show error]
  ok --> done([Done])
sequence:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant U as User
  participant A as API
  participant D as Database
  U->>A: GET /items
  A->>D: SELECT * FROM items
  D-->>A: rows
  A-->>U: 200 JSON
  Note over U,A: Client retries on 5xx
state:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Parsing : input
  Parsing --> Layout : model
  Layout --> Draw : boxes
  Draw --> Idle : svg
  Parsing --> Error : bad syntax
  Error --> Idle : reset
gantt:
gantt
  title Pele render pipeline
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  axisFormat %m-%d
  section Parse
  Lexer :a1, 2024-01-01, 5d
  Parser :a2, after a1, 4d
  section Render
  Layout :b1, after a2, 6d
  SVG :b2, after b1, 3d
  Review :milestone, m1, after b2, 0d
xychart:
xychart-beta
  title "Render time by diagram type"
  x-axis [flowchart, sequence, class, state, er]
  y-axis "milliseconds" 0 --> 100
  bar [45, 38, 30, 28, 25]
  line [40, 35, 28, 26, 22]
mindmap:
mindmap
  root((Pele))
    Parse
      Mermaid syntax
      Custom parsers
    Layout
      Boxes
      Edges
    Render
      SVG
      CSS variables
timeline:
timeline
  title Pele milestones
  section 2023
    Prototype : Obsidian plugin
  section 2024
    Public API : pele.run
    v1.0 : npm package
  section 2025
    v1.9 : themeable SVG
journey:
journey
  title Render a diagram
  section Author
    Write Mermaid: 5: User
    Paste into note: 4: User
  section Render
    Parse text: 3: App
    Layout boxes: 4: App
    Output SVG: 5: App
gitgraph:
gitGraph
  commit id: "init"
  branch feature
  checkout feature
  commit id: "work"
  commit id: "tests"
  checkout main
  merge feature
  commit id: "release"
quadrant:
quadrantChart
  title Diagram candidates
  x-axis Slow --> Fast
  y-axis Limited --> Rich
  quadrant-1 Adopt
  quadrant-2 Evaluate
  quadrant-3 Skip
  quadrant-4 Watch
  Flowchart: [0.9, 0.8]
  Gantt: [0.7, 0.6]
  Mindmap: [0.6, 0.3]
  C4: [0.3, 0.7]
c4:
C4Context
  title Diagram rendering
  Person(user, "User")
  System(app, "dsh-pele")
  System_Ext(pele, "pele")
  Rel(user, app, "asks for diagram")
  Rel(app, pele, "renders SVG")
sankey:
sankey-beta
  Markdown,Mermaid text,100
  Mermaid text,Pele,100
  Pele,SVG,100
block:
block-beta
  columns 3
  md["Markdown"] mermaid["Mermaid text"] pele["Pele"]
  pele --> svg["SVG"]
kanban:
kanban
  todo[Todo]
    t1[Write parser]
  doing[Doing]
    t2[Render SVG]
  done[Done]
    t3[Ship v1.9]
architecture:
architecture-beta
  group api(cloud)[API]
  service db(database)[Database] in api
  service server(server)[Server] in api
  service cache(disk)[Cache] in api
  db:L -- R:server
  server:L -- R:cache
agentflow:
agentflow-beta LR
  a[Receive note] --> b[Parse Mermaid]
  b --> c[Render SVG]
  c --> d[Embed result]
usecase:
usecase-beta
  actor User
  usecase(Login)
  User --> Login
  User --> Logout
  User --> Register
treeview:
treeView-beta
  root
    src
      index.ts
      render.ts
    dist
      pele.js
venn:
venn-beta
  title Ownership
  set A["Pele"]
  set B["Mermaid"]
  union A,B["Mermaid syntax"]
cynefin:
cynefin-beta
  title Domains
  clear
    "Mermaid syntax is known"
  complicated
    "Layout needs analysis"
  complex
    "Themes are emergent"
  clear --> complex
wardley:
wardley-beta
  title Rendering stack
  anchor user[0.62,0.90]
  component markdown[0.45,0.85]
  component pele[0.55,0.45]
  component svg[0.75,0.70]
  user --> markdown
  markdown --> pele
  pele --> svg
swimlane:
swimlane-beta LR
  subgraph Author
    a[Write text]
  end
  subgraph App
    b[Render]
  end
  a --> b
ishikawa:
ishikawa-beta
  title Why diagrams are slow
  effect Slow render
  cause Syntax
    reason Huge input
    reason Deep nesting
  cause Layout
    reason Many edges
    reason Wide labels
eventmodeling:
eventmodeling
  tf 1 command AddItem
  tf 2 event ItemAdded
  tf 3 readmodel Cart
  tf 4 processor Recalculate
